reviews.text: The cap cracked during shipping and leaked all over the box.
The glaze was too watery and ran off the salad instead of sticking.
It tasted more like sweet syrup than aged balsamic vinegar.
The bottle arrived sticky, and the seal looked like it had already been opened.
The flavor was okay, but it was too thin to use as a finishing drizzle.
I expected a rich, tangy reduction, but this tasted flat and watery.
